## Requirements

<a id="BreathOf"></a>

### The breath of a moment

`BreathOf` · `src/product.ts:77` · status: **held**

The breath a moment of a practice follows: the setting of the most specific level that has one (an exercise, then the step, then the sequence, then the pose), applied to the person's pattern, or to the default one.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ fallback, time }) => (person: BreathPattern | undefined, levels: readonly (BreathSetting | undefined)[]): BreathPattern => {
    const base = person ?? fallback
    const setting = levels.find((x) => x !== undefined) as Partial<{ exact: BreathPattern; speed: number; ratio: Record<BreathPhase, number> }> | undefined
    const each = (f: (phase: BreathPhase) => number): BreathPattern =>
      ({ inhale: time.second(f(BreathPhase.inhale)), holdTop: time.second(f(BreathPhase.holdTop)), exhale: time.second(f(BreathPhase.exhale)), holdBottom: time.second(f(BreathPhase.holdBottom)) })
    const { exact, speed, ratio } = setting ?? {}
    if (exact !== undefined) return exact
    if (speed !== undefined) return each((p) => base[p] / speed)
    if (ratio !== undefined) return each((p) => (ratio[p] / ratio.inhale) * base.inhale)
    return base
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `fallback` ← [The breath of someone who has set nothing](#DefaultBreath) · `time` ← [Time](../.trame/std/docs/measures.md#Time)
- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](#BreathSetsThePace)
- Used by: [A practice](practice.md#PracticeOf)
- Applies: [The breath is the clock](principles.md#BreathIsTheClock)
- Used by: [Sequences](content.md#Sequences)

<a id="BreathOfCriteria"></a>

**Criteria of the breath of a moment · owner: ghalaax**

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Without any setting, the person's own breath | passed |
| The most specific level wins: an exercise's exact timings over its pose's ratio | passed |
| A ratio is scaled on the person's inhale: the exhale twice as long | passed |
| Twice the speed halves each phase | passed |

<a id="ChosenLanguage"></a>

### The language of the app

`ChosenLanguage` · `src/product.ts:117` · status: **held**

The one the person chose, if it is offered; otherwise the first of the device's languages that is offered; otherwise the first language offered.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ tags, sequences, texts }) => (offered: readonly string[], chosen: string | undefined, device: readonly string[]): string => {
    const base = (tag: string) => {
      const [language] = tag.split(tags.separator)
      return language
    }
    if (chosen !== undefined && offered.includes(chosen)) return chosen
    return device.map(base).find((tag) => offered.includes(tag)) ?? sequences.head(offered) ?? texts.empty
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `tags` ← [Language tags](../.trame/std/docs/measures.md#LanguageTags) · `sequences` ← [Sequences](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Sequences) · `texts` ← [Texts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Texts)
- Refines: [In the person's language](#InTheirLanguage)
- Used by: [The app's language](language.md#AppLanguage)
- Applies: [The person's language, among those offered](principles.md#LanguageOffered)

## Decision

<a id="DefaultBreath"></a>

### The breath of someone who has set nothing

`DefaultBreath` · `src/product.ts:66`

The pattern a practice follows until the person sets their own, in the settings or by tapping their breath: four seconds in, four seconds out, no pause at the top or at the bottom. A product decision.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| inhale | 4 s |
| holdTop | 0 h |
| exhale | 4 s |
| holdBottom | 0 h |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Rejected: A timer in seconds, the person would follow a clock instead of their breath
- Used by: [The breath of a moment](#BreathOf), [Show the settings](settings.md#ShowSettings)
- Used by: [Poses](content.md#Poses)
